# Lab 6.6: Query Optimisation Best Practices

## What We Are Going to Do
Fix four common anti-patterns and measure bytes and slot time before and after each fix.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Select only the columns you need.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">-- Before
SELECT * FROM lab06.trips_flat WHERE company = 'Flash Cab' LIMIT 10;
-- After
SELECT unique_key, fare FROM lab06.trips_flat WHERE company = 'Flash Cab' LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `LIMIT` does not reduce bytes. Fewer columns does.

2. **[SQL] Filter before you join.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">-- Before: join everything, then filter
SELECT u.country, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON i.user_id = u.id
WHERE i.status = 'Returned' GROUP BY u.country;
-- After: reduce each side first
WITH r AS (SELECT user_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status = 'Returned'),
     u AS (SELECT id, country FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`)
SELECT u.country, COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN u ON r.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.country;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Compare **Slot time**. The optimiser often does this for you, but writing it explicitly keeps it predictable.

3. **[SQL] Avoid repeating an expensive CTE.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">-- A CTE referenced twice can be computed twice; a temp table is computed once
CREATE TEMP TABLE company_stats AS
SELECT company, AVG(fare) AS avg_fare FROM lab06.trips_flat GROUP BY company;
SELECT * FROM company_stats WHERE avg_fare &gt; 20
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM company_stats WHERE avg_fare &lt; 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Avoid ORDER BY without LIMIT on big results**, and use `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT` where exact is not needed.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT taxi_id, SUM(fare) AS total FROM lab06.trips_flat GROUP BY taxi_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 100;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Compare all runs.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(query, r"\s+", " "), 60) AS q, total_bytes_processed, total_slot_ms
 FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
 WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND statement_type = "SELECT"
 ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 10'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Fewer columns | Fewer bytes billed |
| `LIMIT` | Does not reduce bytes |
| Temp table | Expensive result computed once |
| Measuring | Use bytes and slot time, not just elapsed time |
